thesis: AZTA has an intact uptrend (close 46.78 above SMA20 43.2, SMA50 39.0, SMA200 29.0, RS63 +0.51), accelerating revenue (+12.0% YoY), and a net cash balance sheet, with no binary event before 2027-02-03 earnings. But the 2.7 R/R depends on a 54.4 target that needs a clean break of the 50.06 high set on an unexplained gap; the first resistance gives only about 1.3 R/R, and this is in a 0.9-confidence risk-off tape on a thin half-day session. With beta 1.47, ATR 6.2%, a history of gap reversals and a stop one bad day away (42.9 vs SMA20 43.2), the bear's case is the stronger one for opening a position today, so we wait for confirmation rather than buy.
invalidation: Daily close below 42.90 (under the 43.15 Nov 13 swing low) or a close back below SMA20 (about 43.2) on rising volume.
